description: This file implements the TrustyConfirmationUI class, which handles user confirmation UI interactions in an Android environment, including message fetching, session management, and callback handling.

classes.name: TrustyConfirmationUI
classes.description: A class managing the Trusty confirmation UI, including session handling, message fetching, and user interaction.

methods.name: GetVirtioConsoleDevicePath
methods.description: Returns the device path for the virtio console used by the UI.

methods.name: TrustyConfirmationUI
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UI, setting up device communication, and starting message fetch thread.

methods.name: ~TrustyConfirmationUI
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and threads.

methods.description: Continuously fetches messages from the host device and updates the current session.

methods.description: Starts a user confirmation session with provided parameters.
